bull-with-bent-legs.description: The bull of the zodiac wheel, drawn in brown ink over a pale tan, parchment-toned body. It lunges diagonally down to the left with its head lowered and short horns forward, the forelegs folded under the chest, the hind legs stretched up to the right and the tail curling over the rump; a small red fleck marks one hoof. Transparent background.
bull-with-bent-legs.quality: The hind leg at the upper right is truncated where the circular rule of the diagram cut it, and the body keeps the parchment tone of the page as opaque fill.
bull-with-bent-legs.title: Taurus, the bull
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

centaur-archer-with-bow.description: The centaur archer of the zodiac wheel, a pale tan horse body with a green-faced human torso, galloping to the left while drawing a bow with the arrow pointed left. The mane and tail are streaked brown with a red tip, the hooves are dark, and the outlines are brown ink over parchment tone. Transparent background.
centaur-archer-with-bow.quality: The edges are soft, about a fifth of the painted pixels sit at partial alpha, so a faint halo shows on dark grounds; the body keeps the parchment tone as opaque fill.
centaur-archer-with-bow.title: Sagittarius, the centaur archer
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

eight-legged-zodiac-crab.description: The crab of the zodiac wheel seen from above, a pale tan oval body with a dotted brown spine, a small round head with two scroll-shaped eyes at the top and four pairs of forked legs curling upward on either side; the body tapers to a pointed tail at the bottom. Brown ink with faint green traces along the legs. Transparent background.
eight-legged-zodiac-crab.quality: Thin green fringes from the green ground of the diagram cling to the leg outlines.
eight-legged-zodiac-crab.title: Cancer, the crab
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

figure-holding-balance-scales.description: The Libra figure of the zodiac wheel, a seated person in a long pale robe with short curly hair, turned to the right with both arms extended to hold a balance whose beam tilts upward and carries a hanging pan at each end; one bare foot shows below the hem. Brown ink over parchment tone with light green shading. Transparent background.
figure-holding-balance-scales.quality: The figure keeps the parchment tone of the page as opaque fill.
figure-holding-balance-scales.title: Libra, seated figure with scales
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

goat-headed-fish-tailed-capricorn.description: The Capricorn of the zodiac wheel, a goat with long curved horns, a bearded head and raised forelegs facing right, whose body ends at the left in a coiled fish tail with a mask-like knob at the tip. The body is tan with brown ink, the tail and belly are washed green, and a red band circles one foreleg. Transparent background.
goat-headed-fish-tailed-capricorn.quality: The green wash on the tail is worn and mottled where pigment has flaked.
goat-headed-fish-tailed-capricorn.title: Capricorn, goat with fish tail
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

lion-with-curled-tail.description: The lion of the zodiac wheel striding to the right with its mouth open, a shaggy mane, a long tail that curls up over the back and ends in a tuft, and four clawed paws. The body is pale tan parchment tone outlined in brown ink, and it leans slightly as it sat on the wheel. Transparent background.
lion-with-curled-tail.quality: The pigment is worn, so the mane reads as a brown smudge, and the body keeps the parchment tone as opaque fill.
lion-with-curled-tail.title: Leo, the lion
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

mail-clad-twins-with-shared-shield.description: The twins of the zodiac wheel as two soldiers in mail coifs and knee-length hauberks standing with a tall kite-shaped shield between them; the left one raises a sword with a red-tipped hilt, the right one holds a mace. Brown ink over parchment tone with a small red mark on the shield. Transparent background.
mail-clad-twins-with-shared-shield.quality: The lower legs and feet are truncated where the circular rule of the diagram cut them.
mail-clad-twins-with-shared-shield.title: Gemini, twin soldiers with one shield
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

ram-with-curled-horns.description: The ram of the zodiac wheel facing left with a large spiral horn, a shaggy fleece drawn in flame-like brown strokes along the neck and back, cloven hooves and a tail curling down at the right. Pale tan parchment tone outlined in brown ink. Transparent background.
ram-with-curled-horns.quality: The body keeps the parchment tone of the page as opaque fill.
ram-with-curled-horns.title: Aries, the ram
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

red-quatrefoil-from-wind-wheel.description: A single red quatrefoil, four rounded lobes around a square centre, painted with a soft uneven brush edge and slightly darker at the top lobe. One of the fillers painted on the green ring between the roundels of the wind wheel. Transparent background.
red-quatrefoil-from-wind-wheel.quality: The brush edge is soft, so about a third of the painted pixels sit at partial alpha and the outline blurs on a light ground.
red-quatrefoil-from-wind-wheel.title: Red quatrefoil from the wind wheel
usage_notes: Small motif; it repeats well as a bullet or a filler between items. Each quatrefoil on the wheel is hand-painted and differs slightly; only this one is cut out.

robed-water-bearer-pouring-round-jar.description: The water bearer of the zodiac wheel, a figure in a green pleated robe striding to the right with a large round green jar raised at shoulder height, from which a wavy tan stream of water pours out to the right. Brown hair, bare feet and brown ink outlines. Transparent background.
robed-water-bearer-pouring-round-jar.title: Aquarius, water bearer with jar
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

robed-woman-with-outstretched-arms.description: The Virgo figure of the zodiac wheel, a woman in a long flowing olive-tan robe whose skirt spreads to the left, with both arms stretched out and her head turned to the right; the hands and hem carry touches of green. Brown ink over worn parchment tone. Transparent background.
robed-woman-with-outstretched-arms.quality: The pigment is heavily worn, so the figure reads as a tan silhouette with faint brown drawing.
robed-woman-with-outstretched-arms.title: Virgo, woman with outstretched arms
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

two-linked-zodiac-fish.description: The two fish of the zodiac wheel, one above the other and swimming in opposite directions, the upper fish heading right and the lower heading left. Both are mottled green over tan with brown fins, and a long brown cord runs from the mouth of the upper fish in a loop to the mouth of the lower one. Transparent background.
two-linked-zodiac-fish.quality: Thin green fringes from the green ground of the diagram cling to the outlines.
two-linked-zodiac-fish.title: Pisces, two linked fish
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

wind-diagram-with-twelve-profile-heads.description: The complete wind diagram of the folio, a wheel whose broad green outer ring holds twelve roundels, each with a pale profile head blowing a green ray of breath toward the centre, with red quatrefoils between the roundels. Inscriptions in brown and red fill the ring and run along twelve red-ruled spokes from a small central disc through two inner concentric rings. The blank parchment inside the rings and outside the wheel is transparent.
wind-diagram-with-twelve-profile-heads.quality: The green ring is worn and patchy and the brown ink of the inscriptions is faint in places; the heads and the ring keep the parchment tone of the page as opaque fill.
wind-diagram-with-twelve-profile-heads.title: Rota of the winds with twelve heads
usage_notes: The inscriptions, spokes and rings are part of the diagram and are kept; for a single blowing head use the wind-head assets, which are cut from this master and turned upright.
Blank parchment is transparent, so the counters of the lettering show whatever sits behind the wheel; it reads best on a light ground.

wind-head-01.description: The profile head from the roundel at the 12 o'clock position of the wind rota, facing right with the mouth open and blowing. Long hair streaked brown and green falls behind the head to the shoulder, the ear shows, the open mouth holds a green tongue of breath, the cheek and forehead carry red patches, and a long neck with a hint of collar runs to the bottom. Pale parchment-toned face drawn in brown ink. Transparent background.
wind-head-01.quality: The face keeps the parchment tone of the page as opaque fill, and the left edge is the cut along the roundel rather than a drawn outline.
wind-head-01.title: Wind head 1, 12 o'clock
usage_notes: Cut from the wind diagram of fol. 1v and turned upright to face right; in the rota the twelve heads face the centre. All twelve are at the same scale.

wind-head-02.description: The profile head from the roundel at the 1 o'clock position of the wind rota, facing right with the mouth open and blowing. A round head with hair combed back in brown strokes, a large ear, an open mouth with a green puff of breath and a red cheek; the back of the head and the chin follow the circle of the roundel. Pale parchment-toned face drawn in brown ink. Transparent background.
wind-head-02.quality: The face keeps the parchment tone of the page as opaque fill, and the left edge is the cut along the roundel rather than a drawn outline.
wind-head-02.title: Wind head 2, 1 o'clock
usage_notes: Cut from the wind diagram of fol. 1v and turned upright to face right; in the rota the twelve heads face the centre. All twelve are at the same scale.

wind-head-03.description: The profile head from the roundel at the 2 o'clock position of the wind rota, facing right with the mouth open and blowing. Hair in long brown strokes with red streaks, red lips around a green ray of breath blown to the right, a red cheek and a small crescent of neck below. Pale parchment-toned face drawn in brown ink. Transparent background.
wind-head-03.quality: The face keeps the parchment tone of the page as opaque fill, and the left edge is the cut along the roundel rather than a drawn outline.
wind-head-03.title: Wind head 3, 2 o'clock

Long straight hair in brown strokes, an ear, a green ray of breath blown out to the right, a red cheek, and a long chin and neck; the master is cropped flush at the left. Pale parchment-toned face drawn in brown ink. Transparent background.
wind-head-04.quality: The face keeps the parchment tone of the page as opaque fill, and the left edge is the cut along the roundel rather than a drawn outline.

The head tips forward so the face looks down to the right, the hair carries green strokes, a green blot of breath sits at the mouth, the cheek is red, and a wide crescent of bare neck fills the lower left. Pale parchment-toned face drawn in brown ink. Transparent background.

Pale parchment-toned face drawn in brown ink. Transparent background.

winged-two-necked-zodiac-creature.description: The creature standing for Scorpio on the zodiac wheel, a winged beast with two long necks rising from a feathered body, one ending in a beaked head at the top and the other looping down to the left; the broad wing spreads to the right and the tail ends in a red band and a cross-hatched tip. Tan parchment tone with brown ink. Transparent background.
